dogecoin.text: Dogecoin's rally looks strong on the hourly, but whales have been tapping that sell wall harder than my screen during Crypto Thirsty Thursdays. On-chain data suggests buying is pure degen euphoria, but hey - "YOLO" rhymes with "FOMO" for a reason.

Dogecoin's 2023 rally has "much wow" energy - that retro internet meme vibe merging with real degen FOMO. For real tho, check that massive volume spike + Elon's Twitter acquisition. Fundamentals =/= rational markets, but $DOGE is eating zeros again!
